responses.listing:
To create a good listing:

1. Open Sell Animal.
2. Select the animal type.
3. Add at least one clear photo.
4. Fill breed, price, and required details.
5. Submit the listing for review.

Tip: Clear photos and accurate breed/price details help buyers trust your listing.
responses.milkReports:
Milk Reports help you track daily milk, income, expenses, and profit for your animals.

Add your animal first, then add daily milk entries. The dashboard shows useful summaries so you can compare performance and make better feeding or selling decisions.
responses.veterinarian: Open Veterinarian to find vets near you. Check the vet profile, distance, services, and contact options. For fever, injury, low appetite, pregnancy issues, or sudden weakness, contact a vet as early as possible.
responses.filters: Use filters on the Buy Animals page to narrow results by animal type, breed, price, and location. Remove filters anytime to see all available listings again.
responses.wishlist: Tap the heart icon on an animal card to save it. Open Wishlist later to compare saved animals by price, breed, distance, and seller details.
responses.profile: Complete your profile with name, phone, photo, city, state, and location. Correct location helps show nearby animals, buyers, and veterinarians more accurately.
responses.sell: For selling, use a clear photo, correct breed, fair price, and honest animal details. Avoid hiding health problems. A complete and truthful listing builds buyer trust.
responses.buy: Before buying, check photos, breed, price, seller details, location, and health condition. Visit the animal if possible and avoid full advance payment before verification.
responses.price: Animal price depends on breed, age, health, milk capacity, pregnancy status, location, and market demand. Compare similar listings before deciding a fair price.
responses.health: For health issues, watch appetite, fever, breathing, movement, stool, urine, and visible wounds. If the animal stops eating, has high fever, cannot stand, or has breathing trouble, contact a veterinarian immediately.
responses.feeding: Give clean water, suitable green fodder, dry fodder, and balanced concentrate based on animal type, age, and milk production. Sudden diet changes should be avoided.
responses.vaccination: Keep vaccination and deworming records updated. Cattle usually need regular FMD and other recommended vaccines. Confirm the exact schedule with a local veterinarian.
responses.location: Set your location from profile so nearby buyers, sellers, and veterinarians can be shown more accurately. Location also improves map and distance features.
responses.pregnancy: Use the Pregnancy Calendar to track mating date, expected delivery, reminders, and care notes. Contact a vet if there is abnormal discharge, weakness, fever, or delivery difficulty.
responses.disease: Common problems include FMD, mastitis, worms, fever, injuries, and digestive issues. Early treatment is important. If symptoms are severe or unclear, contact a veterinarian.
responses.default: I can help with buying and selling animals, price guidance, health care, feeding, vaccination, milk reports, pregnancy calendar, veterinarians, wishlist, profile, and app features. What would you like to know?

legal.termsIntro: These terms explain the basic rules for using Animal E Bazar on mobile. By continuing to use the app, you agree to use it responsibly and provide accurate information.
legal.termsUseBody: Use the app only for lawful buying, selling, support, and veterinary discovery. Do not misuse the platform, impersonate others, or interfere with normal app usage.
legal.termsListingsBody: You are responsible for the correctness of animal details, prices, images, and location information you submit. Misleading or duplicate listings may be removed.
legal.termsVetBody: Veterinarian information, seller details, call actions, and WhatsApp actions are provided to help users connect directly. Users should still verify suitability before taking medical or purchase decisions.
legal.termsSafetyBody: Keep your OTP, login access, and device secure. You are responsible for activity performed through your account until you report misuse or update your access details.
legal.termsChangesBody: We may improve, pause, or update parts of the app to keep the platform reliable. Continued use after an update means you accept the revised terms.
legal.privacyIntro: This policy explains what information Animal E Bazar may collect in the mobile app, how it is used, and what control you have over your account details.
legal.privacyCollectedBody: We may collect your phone number, profile details, pincode, location details, listing content, uploaded photos, and actions you take inside the app such as reviews, wishlist activity, and contact attempts.
legal.privacyUseBody: Your data is used to create your account, show relevant listings, improve nearby results, support veterinarian discovery, secure OTP login, and keep the app working properly.
legal.privacySharingBody: Public listing details, seller details, and veterinarian profile details may be shown to other users where needed for marketplace and support features. We do not publish private account data beyond what the feature requires.
legal.privacySecurityBody: We take reasonable steps to protect account data, uploaded media, and login flows. Even so, users should avoid sharing OTPs or sensitive credentials with anyone.
legal.privacyChoicesBody: You can update profile details, adjust listing content, and contact support for help with account issues. Continued use of the app after policy updates means the revised privacy policy applies.
